39:62.arabic: ٱللَّهُ خَـٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَكِيلٌۭ
39:62.translation: Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is, over all things, Disposer of affairs.
